title: sbom-unifier: Integration Framework for Heterogeneous SBOMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.30708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) is a machine-readable inventory of software components, increasingly required for vulnerability management and license compliance. However, existing SBOM generation tools often leave many SPDX-defined fields missing or only partially populated, because different tools produce heterogeneous outputs with uneven field-level coverage. We present sbom-unifier, a framework that improves SBOM completeness through field-level integration and complementation of multiple tool outputs and file-level enrichment. Unlike existing tools that simply concatenate SBOMs without identifying records referring to the same component, sbom-unifier identifies components via Package URL (PURL), complements missing field values by a deterministic priority-based strategy, reconstructs cross-section references, and further enriches file-level fields. translated_abstract: 软件物料清单（SBOM）是一种机器可读的软件组件清单，在漏洞管理和许可证合规方面的需求日益增长。然而，现有的SBOM生成工具往往导致许多SPDX定义的字段缺失或仅被部分填充，因为不同工具产生的输出是异构的，字段级覆盖程度参差不齐。我们提出了sbom-unifier，这是一个通过对多个工具输出进行字段级集成与互补以及文件级充实来提高SBOM完整性的框架。与现有工具只是简单拼接SBOM而不识别指向同一组件的记录不同，sbom-unifier通过包URL（PURL）识别组件，采用确定性的基于优先级的策略补充缺失的字段值，重建跨部分的引用关系，并进一步充实文件级字段。在涵盖9种编程语言的90个开源项目中，sbom-unifier保留了……
tldr: sbom-unifier是一个通过基于PURL的组件识别、确定性优先级策略的字段补充、跨部分引用重建和文件级充实来整合异构SBOM并显著提升其字段完整性的框架。
